description:
PUT /v1/account/ibm-connection body: the user's IBM Quantum API key and instance.

Checked with IBM synchronously (within 20 s) before anything is saved; on an
existing connection it is a replace. Unknown fields are refused.

crn.description: The Cloud Resource Name of the IBM Quantum instance to run on. The server checks its shape (a malformed CRN is 422 validation_error on field crn).
crn.title: Crn

token.description: The IBM Quantum API key. Write-only: never returned or logged.
token.title: Token

title: IbmConnectionIn
